title: tithymalus adenochlorus
intro: Tithymalus adenochlorus, commonly known as Euphorbia adenochora or Green Dragon Euphorbia, is a succulent plant species in the spurge family (Euphorbiaceae). It is traditionally used in medicine to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Tithymalus adenochlorus include reducing pain and inflammation, treating wounds, and managing gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
